title: Procedure Text
summary: Technical and instructional literacy: analyzing goals, materials, sequence steps, imperative syntax, troubleshooting conditionals, and ensuring procedural safety.

lessons.title: The Structural Triad: Goal, Materials/Equipment, and Method

blocks.html:
Instructional Literacy: Understanding How Things Work

A Procedure Text (or instructional text) guides readers to achieve a specific outcome through a clearly ordered, reproducible sequence of actions. Examples range from culinary recipes and scientific experiment protocols to electronic device manuals and emergency evacuation procedures.

blocks.title: Real-World Context: Why Surgical Checklists and Cockpit Manuals Save Lives
blocks.html: When an airline pilot prepares for takeoff or a surgical team prepares for open-heart surgery, they do not rely on improvised memory. They follow a rigorous Procedure Text: a clear, step-by-step instruction protocol. Missing a single step in a procedure manual can lead to an airplane stall or an unbaked cake!

blocks.title: Historical Insight: Donald Norman and The Design of Everyday Things
blocks.html:
Tokoh: Donald A. Norman Tahun: 1988 M Krisis: Users fail to assemble critical machinery or bake recipes properly because instruction manuals omit prerequisite tools or mix steps out of order.

Cognitive scientist Donald Norman in The Design of Everyday Things (1988) analyzed instructional ergonomics, proving that human execution error plummets when instructional procedures follow a clean three-part structural triad with clear constraints.

blocks.title: Conceptual Definition: The Generic Structure of Procedure Texts
blocks.html: A Procedure Text explains how to make, operate, or achieve something through a sequence of steps. Generic Structure: 1. Goal / Aim (Often stated in the Title: e.g., 'How to Calibrate a Digital Microscope'). 2. Materials / Ingredients / Equipment (The complete list of required components with exact quantities). 3. Method / Steps (The numbered, chronological series of imperative actions).

blocks.title: Tripartite Anatomy of Procedure Texts
blocks.html:
1. Goal (Aim) → 2. Ingredients / Tools → 3. Steps (Method)
Tahap / KomponenFungsi Retoris / MaknaCiri Kebahasaan / Contoh Penerapan
1. Goal (Aim)States the final desired objective or output productTitle or opening sentence
2. Ingredients / ToolsQuantified list: '200 ml of ethanol', 'Phillips screwdriver', 'sterile gloves'Prerequisite inventory
3. Steps (Method)Sequenced actions using imperative verbs and sequential temporal signpostsExecution pathway

Pedagogical Note: In reading comprehension questions: Pay special attention to prerequisites (what MUST be done before Step 3 can begin).

blocks.title: Simulasi Interaktif: Rekonstruksi Urutan Prosedur Teknis
blocks.caption: Uji ketajaman logika Anda merangkai langkah-langkah eksperimen laboratorium yang teracak.

blocks.title: Tipe Pertanyaan TKA pada Teks Prosedur
blocks.html:
1. What must be done immediately prior to step 4? (Mencari aksi prasyarat).
  2. What is the function of adding substance X? (Menganalisis tujuan spesifik satu langkah).
  3. Who is the intended audience of this manual? (Menentukan target pembaca).

blocks.title: Applied Analytical Scenario: The Structural Triad: Goal, Materials/Equipment, and Method
blocks.question: How can a critical reader analyze and verify discourse arguments regarding 'The Structural Triad: Goal, Materials/Equipment, and Method' based on principles articulated by Donald A. Norman?

steps.step: Identify Textual Claims and Operational Constraints
steps.explanation: Examine the core assertions in the target text and locate the explicit warrants connecting premises to the central thesis of The Structural Triad: Goal, Materials/Equipment, and Method.

steps.step: Evaluate Evidence Quality and Rhetorical Framing
steps.explanation: Cross-examine whether the supporting data meets scholarly standards, checking for potential logical fallacies or biases.

steps.step: Synthesize Authorial Stance and Strategic Implications
steps.explanation: Determine the underlying communicative purpose and synthesize actionable conclusions aligned with Donald A. Norman's framework.

blocks.answer: By systematically evaluating textual evidence and logical structure, readers can resolve complex comprehension challenges regarding The Structural Triad: Goal, Materials/Equipment, and Method with critical confidence.

blocks.title: Comprehension Check: The Structural Triad: Goal, Materials/Equipment, and Method
blocks.question: Which of the following statements most accurately reflects the core principle established by Donald A. Norman regarding 'The Structural Triad: Goal, Materials/Equipment, and Method'?

options.A: The concept relies entirely on subjective guesswork without requiring any textual or empirical justification.
options.B: The principle provides a rigorous analytical framework grounded in verifiable evidence and coherent logical relations.
options.C: The rule is completely obsolete and has been universally rejected by all modern academic institutions.
options.D: The structure can only be applied when reading ancient fictional poetry and is invalid for academic prose.
options.E: The framework mandates that readers must accept all internet claims without checking author credibility.

blocks.explanation: Option B is correct. In academic discourse, The Structural Triad: Goal, Materials/Equipment, and Method establishes systematic criteria for rigorous critical analysis. Option A is incorrect because validity requires evidence. Option C is false as the framework remains foundational. Option D is incorrect because it applies across academic genres. Option E contradicts the principles of critical evaluation.
blocks.hint: Identify the option emphasizing evidence-based reasoning, logical consistency, and scholarly integrity.

lessons.title: Imperative Syntax, Action Verbs, and Precise Adverbs of Manner

blocks.html:
Command Syntax: The Imperative Mood

Unlike descriptive or narrative texts that use declarative sentences, procedure texts employ the imperative mood. The sentence begins directly with an action verb (base form $V_1$), with the grammatical subject 'You' being understood implicitly.

blocks.title: Real-World Context: 'Pour the Solution Gently' vs 'The Solution Was Poured'
blocks.html: Imagine a chemistry laboratory manual stating: 'It would be advisable if someone might consider heating the beaker.' That would invite disaster! Lab manuals use commanding, direct syntax: 'Heat the beaker over a low flame for 3 minutes.' Imperative syntax strips away conversational filler to deliver crystal-clear directives.

blocks.title: Historical Insight: Charles Bally and Stylistique Linguistique
blocks.html:
Tokoh: Charles Bally Tahun: 1913 M Krisis: Instruction steps become vague and verbose when written in passive or descriptive forms instead of crisp imperative action directives.

Swiss linguist Charles Bally (1913), a leading disciple of Saussure, established the stylistic differentiation between expressive affective language and Imperative Technical Language designed for unhindered behavioral execution.

blocks.title: Conceptual Definition: Grammatical Features of Procedural Discourse
blocks.html:
1. Imperative Mood: Clauses begin directly with an action base verb without a stated subject pronoun ('Mix...', 'Insert...', 'Tighten...'; the subject 'you' is tacitly understood).
2. Action Verbs (Material Processes): Physical verbs indicating tangible manipulation of objects.
3. Adverbs of Manner and Degree: Exact execution specifications ('vigorously', 'clockwise', 'until golden brown').

blocks.title: Syntactic Pattern of Procedural Steps
blocks.html:
Base Verb + Direct Object → Precautionary Negatives → Quantified Adverbs of Manner
Tahap / KomponenFungsi Retoris / MaknaCiri Kebahasaan / Contoh Penerapan
Base Verb + Direct ObjectGently insert the USB drive into the port.Core imperative
Precautionary NegativesDo NOT touch the heating element with wet hands.Negative constraint
Quantified Adverbs of MannerStir continuously for precisely ninety seconds.Quality control modifier

Pedagogical Note: Look for adverbs of manner: they provide answers to 'How should the action be carried out?'.

blocks.title: Contoh Analisis Kalimat Imperatif
blocks.question: Instruction: 'Rotate the valve counterclockwise by a quarter turn; never force the mechanism if resistance is felt.' What are the key directives?
steps: Perintah Positif: 'Rotate the valve counterclockwise by a quarter turn' (Putar katup berlawanan arah jarum jam seperempat putaran).
Larangan Mutlak: 'never force the mechanism' (jangan pernah memaksakan mekanisme).
Kondisi Pengecualian: 'if resistance is felt' (jika terasa ada hambatan/tahanan).
blocks.answer: Pengguna harus memutar katup seperempat putaran berlawanan jarum jam, dan wajib segera berhenti jika terasa ada hambatan.

blocks.title: Cek Pemahaman
blocks.question: Which sentence represents a correct IMPERATIVE directive in a technical manual?

options.A: You should be tightening the screw until it clicks.
options.B: Tightening the screw is necessary for safety.
options.C: Tighten the hex screw firmly until an audible click is heard.
options.D: The technician tightened the screw clockwise.

blocks.hint: Kalimat imperatif dimulai langsung dengan Base Verb (V1).
blocks.explanation: 'Tighten the hex screw firmly until an audible click is heard' menggunakan kata kerja dasar imperatif (Tighten) dan adverbia presisi (firmly).

lessons.title: Conditionals in Instructions: If-Clauses, Precautions, and Warnings

blocks.html:
Troubleshooting Logic: Conditionals and Safety Callouts

Professional procedure texts rarely follow a single straight line. Modern manuals incorporate branching conditional statements and safety precautions to handle unexpected errors or anomalies.

blocks.title: Real-World Context: When an Instruction Changes Based on Conditions
blocks.html: A smart oven manual states: 'Bake for 20 minutes; however, if baking at high altitudes above 1,500 meters, increase baking time by 5 minutes.' What happens if you skip that conditional clause? Your cake collapses! Procedural literacy requires active attention to conditional branches, safety precautions, and troubleshooting steps.

blocks.title: Historical Insight: Martin Joos and The Five Clocks of Discourse
blocks.html:
Tokoh: Martin Joos Tahun: 1961 M Krisis: Users ruin electronics or cause laboratory fires by overlooking conditional branch warnings ('If the red light flashes, immediately unplug').

Linguist Martin Joos in The Five Clocks (1961) detailed the 'Formal-Technical' register where conditional clauses function as critical systemic safeguards against cognitive assumption.

blocks.title: Conceptual Definition: Conditional Branching and Safety Warnings
blocks.html: Zero and First Conditionals in Procedures establish contingent workflows based on environmental variables or system states: 'If [Condition occurs], then [Execute corrective action].' Safety Typology: 1. Caution (Risk of equipment damage), 2. Warning (Risk of personal physical injury), 3. Note / Tip (Efficiency recommendation).

blocks.title: Classification of Procedural Conditional Directives
blocks.html:
Troubleshooting Branch → Precautionary Prerequisite → Alternative Method
Tahap / KomponenFungsi Retoris / MaknaCiri Kebahasaan / Contoh Penerapan
Troubleshooting BranchIf bubbles appear on the surface, reduce heat immediately.Adaptive workflow
Precautionary PrerequisiteEnsure the device is powered off before opening the battery cover.Mandatory safety check
Alternative MethodIf a blender is unavailable, a manual whisk may be substituted.Resource flexibility

Pedagogical Note: Exam questions often target: 'What should the user do IF [unforeseen event occurs]?'.

blocks.title: Contoh Analisis Troubleshooting
blocks.question: Manual Step: 'If the device fails to boot and emits three short beeps, inspect the RAM seating. However, if a continuous high-pitched tone is produced, immediately power off the unit to prevent thermal runaway.' What should be done when a continuous tone sounds?
steps: Kondisi 1: Gagal boot + tiga bunyi bip pendek -> periksa dudukan RAM (inspect RAM seating).
Kondisi 2: Bunyi nada tinggi terus-menerus (continuous high-pitched tone) -> segera matikan daya unit (immediately power off).
Tujuan Aksi 2: Mencegah lonjakan panas berlebih (prevent thermal runaway).
blocks.answer: Pengguna harus segera mematikan daya unit perangkat untuk mencegah lonjakan panas berlebih.

blocks.title: Cek Pemahaman
blocks.question: According to an instruction manual: 'If liquid penetrates the keyboard, do NOT attempt to turn on the laptop. Immediately invert the machine and consult an authorized service technician.' What is strictly prohibited?

options.A: Inverting the machine onto a flat surface.
options.C: Powering on the laptop after liquid exposure.

blocks.hint: Perhatikan larangan eksplisit: 'do NOT attempt to turn on the laptop'.
blocks.explanation: Instruksi secara eksplisit melarang menyalakan laptop jika terkena tumpahan cairan guna mencegah korsleting fatal.

lessons.title: Integrating Visual Diagrams, Symbols, and Flowcharts

blocks.html:
Reading Multimodal Instructions: Text Meets Icons

Modern TKA assessments evaluate multimodal literacy—the ability to correlate written instructions with visual symbols, flowcharts, safety pictograms, and exploded assembly diagrams.

blocks.title: Real-World Context: Why Emergency Manuals and IKEA Guides Use Pictures
blocks.html: When assembling furniture or evacuating an aircraft in an emergency, reading paragraphs of fine print is dangerous and inefficient. International safety manuals rely on multimodal literacy: combining concise imperative text with universal hazard icons, directional arrows, and step-by-step schematics.

blocks.title: Historical Insight: Kress and van Leeuwen on Multimodal Literacy
blocks.html:
Tokoh: Gunther Kress & Theo van Leeuwen Tahun: 1996 M Krisis: Test-takers ignore instructional diagrams and safety icons, looking only at text lines and missing crucial warnings.

Linguists Gunther Kress and Theo van Leeuwen published Reading Images: The Grammar of Visual Design (1996). They demonstrated that in procedural and instructional genres, visual symbols, arrows, and layout hierarchy possess their own visual grammar that works synergistically with verbal text.

blocks.title: Conceptual Definition: Multimodal Procedural Text (Text, Icons, Flow Direction)
blocks.html: A Multimodal Procedure Text integrates verbal steps with graphical elements (pictograms, hazard symbols, numbered exploded diagrams, and directional arrows) to guide the user toward error-free task completion.

blocks.title: Multimodal Procedural Deconstruction Blueprint
blocks.html:
Scan Numbered Sequence Layout → Decode Pictograms & Hazard Symbols → Cross-Check Step Text with Corresponding Diagram → Verify Safety Restrictions
Tahap / KomponenFungsi Retoris / MaknaCiri Kebahasaan / Contoh Penerapan
Hazard & Caution IconsTriangles with exclamation marks, skull pictograms, high voltage lightningSignals life-safety precautions that must precede action steps.
Directional VectorsCurved arrows, dashed lines, rotational indicatorsSpecifies the exact physical direction of turning, folding, or inserting.
Exploded Component ViewsLetters or numbers labeling individual parts in the diagramMatches hardware materials (e.g., 'Bolt B') with execution steps.
Reading StrategyWhen text seems ambiguous, check the diagram for spatial orientationResolves confusing prepositional phrases ('insert behind panel X').

Pedagogical Note: Questions featuring diagrams frequently test whether you can spot discrepancies between what the text instructs and what the illustration depicts.

blocks.title: Korelasi Simbol Universal
blocks.html:
• Flammable Symbol (Flame Icon): Jauhkan dari sumber api dan percikan panas.
  • Biohazard Symbol (Trefoil Icon): Limbah biologis infeksius; wajib menggunakan APD khusus.
  • Recycling Arrow Triad (Möbius Strip): Komponen dapat didaur ulang setelah masa pakai habis.
  • Crossed-Out Wheelie Bin: Jangan buang ke tempat sampah domestik umum; bawa ke depo limbah elektronik.

blocks.title: Contoh Soal Sintesis Diagram-Teks
blocks.question: A laboratory manual states: 'Pour 50 mL of hydrochloric acid into the beaker.' Beside the text is an icon showing an acid droplet burning a hand and a metal surface, labeled with a skull. What precautionary measure is implied?
steps: Analisis Simbol: Simbol cairan menetes membakar tangan dan logam menandakan zat sangat korosif (corrosive hazard).
Simbol Tengkorak: Menandakan racun mematikan (acute toxicity).
Sintesis Multimodal: Praktikan wajib mengenakan sarung tangan tahan asam (acid-resistant gloves) dan pelindung mata sebelum menuang asam.
blocks.answer: Tindakan pencegahan mutlak adalah memakai sarung tangan pelindung tahan asam dan kacamata pengaman karena zat bersifat korosif dan berbahaya.

blocks.title: Cek Pemahaman
blocks.question: In an electronic assembly guide, a diagram illustrates a bolt circled with a curved clockwise arrow labeled '15 Nm'. What does this indicate to the assembler?

options.A: Loosen the bolt by turning it counterclockwise.
options.B: Tighten the bolt clockwise with a torque rating of 15 Newton-meters.
options.C: Discard the bolt after 15 days of continuous operation.
options.D: Drill a 15-millimeter hole through the metal plate.

blocks.hint: Panah searah jarum jam (clockwise) dan satuan Nm (Newton-meter) adalah spesifikasi torsi pengencangan baut.
blocks.explanation: Panah searah jarum jam dengan satuan 15 Nm berarti mengencangkan baut ke arah kanan dengan batas torsi 15 Newton-meter.

lessons.title: Evaluating Procedural Efficiency, Omissions, and Target Audience

blocks.html:
Critical Evaluation: Spotting Ambiguity and Missing Steps

Evaluative TKA questions test whether you can identify logical gaps in instructions: 'What essential step did the author omit before step 5?' or 'Why is instruction B ambiguous?'

blocks.title: Real-World Context: The Disaster of Ambiguous Instructions
blocks.html: Imagine reading a medical manual: 'Administer the solution quickly before the patient recovers.' How quickly? How many milligrams? By what method? Ambiguity in instructional writing can lead to ruined machinery, wasted ingredients, or tragic medical accidents. Professional procedures demand rigorous clarity and precision.

blocks.title: Historical Insight: Nielsen and Norman on Usability Heuristics
blocks.html:
Tokoh: Jakob Nielsen & Donald Norman Tahun: 1993 M Krisis: Students cannot identify procedural flaws, omissions, or ambiguities that would cause an ordinary user to make catastrophic errors.

Usability pioneers Jakob Nielsen and Donald Norman (1993) formulated standard heuristics for human-system interaction. They proved that instructional efficiency depends on error prevention: placing warnings before dangerous actions and specifying quantifiable parameters rather than vague adjectives.

blocks.title: Conceptual Definition: Procedural Usability, Precision, and Omission Detection
blocks.html:
Procedural Clarity: The degree to which instructions are unambiguous, quantifiable, sequential, and free of confusing jargon for the intended audience.

Critical Omission: A missing step, unstated tool, or absent safety precaution that prevents successful task completion.

blocks.title: Instructional Clarity Audit Protocol
blocks.html:
Audit Quantifiable Precision (Time, Temp, Volume) → Check Warning Placement (Before Action) → Verify Tool & Material Completeness → Detect Ambiguous Pronouns or Vague Verbs
Tahap / KomponenFungsi Retoris / MaknaCiri Kebahasaan / Contoh Penerapan
Quantifiable Metrics'Bake for 25 minutes at 180°C' vs 'Bake until nice and golden'Precise numbers eliminate subjective guesswork.
Precautionary Precedence'WARNING: Disconnect power cord before opening the casing.'Safety warnings must always precede physical execution steps.
Unambiguous Action Verbs'Tighten the screw clockwise until snug' vs 'Fix the part'Precise physical kinematics prevent mechanical damage.
Question StrategyWhen asked 'What information is missing from step 3?'Look for unstated quantities, absent safety limits, or undefined target parts.

Pedagogical Note: Evaluative questions on procedure texts frequently ask you to spot which step lacks necessary quantitative measurements or precautions.

blocks.title: Kriteria Kejelasan Prosedur yang Baik
blocks.html:
1. Completeness: Setiap alat yang dibutuhkan pada langkah eksekusi harus tercantum di daftar bahan/alat di awal.
  2. Precision: Menghindari instruksi ambigu seperti 'tambahkan sedikit garam' dalam resep sains; harus menggunakan takaran kuantitatif eksak (misal: 'add 2.5 grams').
  3. Safety Warnings Placed First: Peringatan bahaya wajib diletakkan SEBELUM tindakan berisiko dilakukan, bukan setelahnya.

blocks.title: Contoh Analisis Langkah yang Hilang (Omission)
blocks.question:
Step 1: 'Clean the circuit board with alcohol.'
Step 2: 'Solder the replacement capacitor onto pads A and B.'
Step 3: 'Power on the device to test functionality.'
What crucial step is missing between Step 1 and Step 2?
steps: Analisis: Alkohol adalah cairan kimia yang mudah terbakar dan menghantarkan listrik saat masih basah.
Tindakan menyolder (soldering) menghasilkan panas sangat tinggi di atas 300°C.
Langkah krusial yang terlewat: Menunggu papan sirkuit kering sempurna dari sisa cairan alkohol sebelum menyolder agar tidak memicu kebakaran atau korsleting.
blocks.answer: Langkah yang terlewat adalah membiarkan papan sirkuit mengering sepenuhnya sebelum mengaplikasikan solder panas.

blocks.title: Cek Pemahaman
blocks.question: Why is the instruction 'Heat the chemical solution until it gets hot' considered POOR technical writing?

options.B: It lacks an exact measurable temperature threshold, making it ambiguous and dangerous.
options.D: It fails to specify the color of the safety goggles.

blocks.hint: Frasa 'until it gets hot' sangat ambigu dan tidak terukur secara saintifik.
blocks.explanation: Instruksi tersebut buruk karena tidak menyertakan batas temperatur kuantitatif yang terukur secara presisi, menimbulkan risiko kecelakaan laboratorium.

lessons.title: Jebakan Urutan Operasi Bersamaan vs Berurutan

blocks.html:
Sequential vs Simultaneous Execution Traps

In procedural reading tests, questions frequently interrogate the exact chronological relationship between paired actions. Test takers often confuse actions performed sequentially (one after another) with actions performed simultaneously (at the exact same time).

blocks.title: Real-World Context: 'Stir While Heating' vs 'Heat, Then Stir'
blocks.html: Notice the critical difference between these two chemistry protocols: 1. 'Add the acid, then add the water.' (DANGEROUS! Adding water to concentrated acid can cause violent boiling and acid splatter!). 2. 'Add the acid gradually while stirring the water constantly.' In procedural texts, distinguishing between Sequential Operations (one after the other) and Concurrent Operations (simultaneous actions) is a matter of life and safety.

blocks.title: Historical Insight: Alan Turing and Algorithmic Execution States
blocks.html:
Tokoh: Alan Turing Tahun: 1936 M Krisis: Users perform two steps simultaneously that were intended to be executed in strict sequence (or vice versa), causing chemical explosions or software crashes.

Father of modern computer science Alan Turing in his 1936 paper On Computable Numbers formulated the fundamental mechanics of sequential vs concurrent algorithmic state transitions that govern all computational and procedural instruction sequences.

blocks.title: Conceptual Definition: Sequential Precedence vs Concurrent Parallelism
blocks.html: Sequential Operations: Step B cannot initiate until Step A has achieved complete physical termination (indicated by: once, after, following, subsequently). Concurrent / Parallel Operations: Step A and Step B must occur in unison at the exact same time (indicated by: simultaneously, while, concurrently, as you pour, during).

blocks.title: Signaling Matrix: Sequential vs Concurrent Execution
blocks.html:
Strict Sequential Precedence → Simultaneous / Concurrent → Conditional Concurrency
Tahap / KomponenFungsi Retoris / MaknaCiri Kebahasaan / Contoh Penerapan
Strict Sequential PrecedenceOnce the mixture has cooled completely to room temperature, add the enzyme.Prerequisite gatekeeper
Simultaneous / ConcurrentWhisk the batter vigorously while slowly drizzling in the warm milk.Parallel coordination
Conditional ConcurrencyKeep the emergency valve open throughout the heating cycle.Continuous background state

Pedagogical Note: In procedural comprehension tests: Always verify whether an action must be completed before the next step begins, or if they happen at the same time.

blocks.title: Pembeda Kata Kunci Urutan Prosedur
blocks.html:
• Sequential (Berurutan): 'Once the mixture has cooled, add the enzyme.' (Enzim baru boleh dimasukkan SETELAH campuran dingin).
  • Simultaneous (Bersamaan): 'While continuously stirring the flask, slowly inject the reagent.' (Pengadukan dan injeksi reagen wajib dilakukan PADA SAAT BERSAMAAN).

blocks.title: Contoh Identifikasi Tindakan Simultan
blocks.question: Step: 'While monitoring the pressure gauge, slowly depress the relief lever until the needle enters the green zone.' Are these actions sequential or simultaneous?
steps: Konjungsi 'While' di awal kalimat menandakan keserentakan (simultaneity).
Dua tindakan yang berjalan bersamaan: (1) Mengawasi jarum indikator tekanan (monitoring gauge) dan (2) Menekan tuas pelepas secara perlahan (depressing lever).
Kondisi berhenti: saat jarum memasuki zona hijau.
blocks.answer: Kedua tindakan wajib dilakukan secara simultan (bersamaan).

blocks.title: Cek Pemahaman
blocks.question: Read the instruction: 'Add the yeast only after the boiled water has cooled to room temperature.' What happens if yeast is added immediately after boiling?

options.A: The fermentation will proceed at twice the normal velocity.
options.B: The extreme heat will kill the living yeast microorganisms, failing the recipe.
options.C: The mixture will turn into an insoluble solid crystal.
options.D: The container will immediately implode from vacuum pressure.

blocks.hint: Ragi adalah mikroorganisme hidup yang mati jika terkena air mendidih.
blocks.explanation: Suhu air mendidih akan mematikan mikroorganisme ragi, sehingga proses fermentasi gagal total jika instruksi pendinginan dilanggar.

lessons.title: Procedural Reading Assessment and Chapter Quiz

blocks.html:
Mastery Review: Procedure Text

Test your competence across device manuals, culinary recipes, laboratory experiments, and safety protocols in this chapter quiz:

  1. Pay close attention to restrictive conditions ('only after', 'prior to', 'while').
  2. Look out for safety warnings and troubleshooting decision trees.
  3. Differentiate prerequisite steps from final clean-up actions.

blocks.title: Instruksi Pengerjaan
blocks.html: Kuis terdiri atas 20 butir soal terstandar berbasis teks instruksional autentik.

blocks.title: Cheat Sheet: Procedural Texts, Manuals & Imperatives
blocks.subtitle: Summary of goal/aim, materials/tools, action verbs, imperative sentence syntax, and sequential transitions.
blocks.html:
1. Structural Components

  • Goal / Aim: Stated in the title or introductory objective statement (e.g., "How to Calibrate a Spectrophotometer").
  • Materials / Ingredients / Tools: The required apparatus or components listed with quantities.
  • Steps / Methods: Step-by-step instructions presented sequentially.

2. Grammatical Signposts

  • Imperative Sentences: Sentences start with bare action verbs: "Insert the probe...", "Ensure that the valve is closed...", "Do not expose...".
  • Sequencing Signals: First and foremost, next, proceed to, simultaneously, ensure that, finally.

blocks.text: Kuis Uji Kompetensi TKA Bahasa Inggris: Procedure Text (20 Soal Pilihan Ganda Terstandar).
